title: Law to require fireproof battery boxes for delivery e-bikes
summary: This bill would require businesses that use bicycles for commercial purposes to provide their motor-assisted bicycle operators with fireproof or fire-resistant containers for charging removable e-bike batteries, unless the bikes are charged entirely on site. Businesses could not make operators pay for these containers themselves. The Fire Department would set rules for what counts as fireproof or fire-resistant, and the law would take effect 120 days after passage.
